description: Everything needed to use one component correctly: its exported names, the TypeScript prop signature straight from the build, a props table per export (type, allowed values, default, required, description), its anatomy (parts and data-slot names), best practices, the CSS variables it reads with their defaults, the import line and a link to its documentation page. Also answers for hooks (signature, parameters, return value, notes), providers and utilities (useToast, ThemeProvider …).

name.description: Export name ("DataGrid"), slug ("data-grid") or title ("Data Grid")

title: Get a WunderUI component
